## Quick Reference

- **Getting Started**: See main [README.md](../README.md) for quick start and installation
- **API Testing**: Interactive API docs at `http://localhost:8001/docs` when running locally
- **Service Integration Tests**: See `tests/service/run_tests.py` for end-to-end testing
- **Database Migrations**: `poetry run alembic upgrade head`
- **Seed Data**: `poetry run python scripts/seed-data.py`
